label: Bible Study
prompt: For ye shall go out with _____, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verse: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
note: Creation applauds the return home — mountains singing and trees clapping their hands.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: My _____ be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verse: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
note: After a letter full of hard corrections, Paul signs off simply: 'My love be with you all.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the _____ of God.
verse: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
note: The Ten Commandments came 'written with the finger of God' — Jesus used the same phrase for casting out devils in Luke 11:20.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but _____ the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verse: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
note: John's spirit check: don't believe every voice — the next verse gives the test, confessing Christ come in the flesh.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: I know both how to be _____, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verse: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
note: Paul's contentment covered both extremes: 'abased' and abounding, full and hungry.
